description: Original Ragnarok Online inventory icons for the Ascension Forge Mythic sets. The six original sets (celestial ... infernal) keep their icons; haven-v432 adds six Ragnarok Online themed sets on top of them - Valkyrie, Thanatos and Archangel (Astral Citadel), Ifrit, Thor and Diabolus (Thor Volcano) - each a distinct native item icon per piece taken from the RO item or set it is named after. Inventory icons, not equipped character layers. Pixels preserved; no redraw or recolouring. The haven-v432 icons come from the hvg249/TranslationRO-BR client data (data/texture/유저인터페이스/item/<item id>.bmp, source = its git blob): each BMP was converted to PNG with the magenta key made transparent, pixels otherwise untouched.
